errors.system_account_locked: This is a built-in account: only its name and bank details can be changed.
errors.account_parent_type: The parent account must be an active account of the same type.
errors.account_has_balance: This account still has a balance. Bring it to zero before deactivating it.
errors.account_inactive: This account is deactivated. Choose another account or activate it first.
errors.expense_account_required: Choose an expense category (an expense account).
errors.expense_accounts_only: You can add expense categories only. Ask the owner to add other accounts.
errors.money_account_required: Choose a cash or bank account.
errors.party_required: Customer / supplier accounts need the customer or supplier on the line.
errors.party_not_allowed: Use a customer on customer dues and a supplier on supplier dues.
errors.not_manual: Only journal vouchers can be reversed here. Cancel the bill or document instead.
errors.already_reversed: This entry has already been reversed.
errors.itc_not_allowed: Input tax credit is only for regular GST businesses.
errors.expense_has_payments: Payments have been made against this expense. Cancel those payments first.
errors.shift_already_open: A shift is already open on this counter.
errors.not_own_shift: This is another cashier's shift. Only a manager can change it.
errors.account_in_use: This account receives UPI / card payments. Change the payment setup first.
errors.shift_user_required: A shift belongs to a person. Sign in as the cashier to open it.

validation.account_code_type: Code must start with the type's digit (1 assets, 2 liabilities, 3 capital, 4 income, 5 expenses)
validation.ifsc: Enter a valid IFSC, e.g. SBIN0001234
validation.journal_line_side: Enter a debit or a credit on each line (not both)
validation.journal_unbalanced: Total debit and total credit must be equal
validation.narration_required: Write a short narration (at least 3 letters)
validation.expense_amount_both: Give either the bill total or the amount before GST
validation.itc_requires_gst: Choose the GST rate to claim input credit
validation.supplier_required_for_credit: Choose the supplier you will pay later
validation.paid_from_not_allowed_for_credit: An expense on credit is not paid from cash or bank
validation.denominations_total_mismatch: The note count does not match the amount
validation.cash_entry_counter_both: Choose a reason or an expense head, not both
validation.cash_entry_same_account: Choose an account other than the drawer's own cash
validation.date_order: The start date must not be after the end date

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Rent, electricity, salaries and every other shop expense — so your profit is right.
expenses.empty_description: Record rent, electricity bills, salaries, tea and transport as you pay them. Your daily and monthly profit will then be accurate.
expenses.none_hint: Try another date range or clear the filters.

form.title: Add expense
form.pick_category: Choose what the money was spent on
form.itc_hint: Only when the bill shows your GSTIN.
form.credit_hint: It will show in this supplier's dues until you pay.
form.from_drawer_hint: The open shift's expected cash goes down by this amount.
form.more: Date, bill no., supplier, note, photo

photo.hint: Optional — a photo of the bill helps at audit time.
photo.unavailable: The photo could not be loaded.
photo.file_type: Use a photo (JPG, PNG, WebP) or a PDF.
photo.file_too_large: The file is larger than {{size}} MB.

detail.title: Expense
detail.cancel_description: A reversing entry will be posted today. The expense stays in the list as cancelled.

shifts.title: Shifts & cash
shifts.description: Opening cash, cash in / out and the closing count of every counter — see who is short or excess.
shifts.empty_description: Open a shift at the start of the day with the cash in the drawer, and close it with a note count at the end.

current.none_hint: Count the drawer and open a shift before the first bill.

open.title: Open shift
open.description: Count the cash in the drawer before the first bill.

close.title: Close shift · {{register}}
close.reason_hint: e.g. change given extra, ₹50 note torn. Helps the owner later.
close.confirm_description: The difference is posted to Cash short / excess. A closed shift cannot be reopened.
close.done_hint: The Z report is ready to print.

cash_entry.title: Cash in / out
cash_entry.description: Money put into or taken out of the drawer, other than bills.

shift_report.title: Shift report
shift_report.live_hint: Live figures as of {{time}}; they refresh every minute.
shift_report.no_cash_entries: No cash taken out or put in.

day_book.title: Day book
day_book.description: Everything that happened in the books on one day, with links to each bill and voucher.
day_book.empty_description: Bills, purchases, payments and expenses of the day appear here automatically.

ledgers.title: Ledgers
ledgers.description: Every entry of an account with the running balance — cash book, bank, dues and more.

journal.title: Journal entries
journal.description: Every posting in the books. Add a journal voucher for corrections and adjustments.
journal.empty_title: No journal entries in this period
journal.empty_description: Bills, purchases, payments and expenses post here automatically. Use a journal voucher only for corrections.

form.title: New journal entry
form.description: For corrections and adjustments. Total debit must equal total credit.

reverse.title: Reverse {{number}}?
reverse.description: A mirror entry is posted on the date you choose. This can be done only once.

statements.title: Financial statements
statements.description: Profit & loss, balance sheet and trial balance — straight from your books.
statements.all_stores_hint: Your access is limited to some stores. Ask the owner to view the balance sheet and trial balance.

bs.not_balanced: The balance sheet is off by {{amount}}. Check recent journal entries.

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.description: All accounts with their balances. Add expense heads or another bank account; rename any account.
accounts.none_hint: Try another search or show deactivated accounts.

form.system_hint: Built-in account used by billing and purchases: you can rename it and change bank details.
form.parent_hint: Optional — e.g. put a new bank under Bank accounts.
form.store_hint: Only for one store's cash or bank.
form.account_last4_hint: Kadai never stores the full account number.
form.deactivate_description: It will be hidden from pickers. Its history stays in the books.
form.delete_description: This account has no entries, so it will be removed completely.
